Fix the MCUX CAAM bug affecting RT11XX platforms when using the entropy subsystem

Fixes #50446
Fixes #49440
Fixes #49846

*Note: This message is automatically posted and updated by the Manifest GitHub Action.*

@carlocaione I would like your opinion on the direction of some of the additions in this PR because it relates to an area which you were active in.

In order to enable this driver for the CAAM, I had to make use of nocache memory. The RT11XX has a cortex M4 target that has an NXP kinetis cache. The ARM initialization code in zephyr seems to assume that if there is a cache, the target is an M7, because it calls SCB APIs to clean and invalidate the DCACHE. Because these functions are undefined for the M4 target, I had to specify that this cache is not an ARM cache. I used the HAS_EXTERNAL_CACHE kconfig to do this because it seemed appropriate, but since that option depends on the CACHE_MANAGEMENT symbol, I had to write an empty implementation for an NXP kinetis cache even though it isnt't really used, just in order to satisfy the kernel common test that twister reported would fail if those APIs were not defined. What are your thoughts on this?

> The ARM initialization code in zephyr seems to assume that if there is a cache, the target is an M7, because it calls SCB APIs to clean and invalidate the DCACHE.

This is the base problem. The ARM initialization code must be fixed to not use SCB API calls for cache if `CONFIG_DCACHE` is not defined. See for example: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/1d879b93c59e8f1f48d86db5794600769c86facb/arch/arm/core/aarch32/cortex_m/scb.c#L111-L122

So in your case your SOC must not define `CONFIG_CPU_HAS_DCACHE / CONFIG_DCACHE` and all the call to the SCB should be skipped.
I found a better way to do this, so this PR now will depend on #50871

> I found a better way to do this, so this PR now will depend on #50871

I commented there.
update: the caching problem on m4 is too much of a bottleneck, disabled in devicetree, for now m7 can at least be supported
@mmahadevan108 can you take a look at my responses to your review and let me know what you think

issue_context.title: mimxrt1160_evk network samples stopped working
issue_context.body:
Some commit after v3.1.0 broke the network sample apps when running on the mimxrt1160_evk board.  The problem is seen in the latest main branch, commit d5523386375af720facae445f50e6b1a1c7f7471.  It has also been reported this affects the mimxrt1170_evk as well.  Running the same sample from v3.1.0 boots and starts execution as expected.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, using main branch:
```
west build -b mimxrt1160_evk_cm7 samples\net\cloud\tagoio_http_post --pristine
west flash
```
using the main branch, nothing prints to the console.  When building hello_world from the main branch, it prints to the console correctly.  

**Expected behavior**
using v3.1.0 release, after the same steps above, the below messages print to the console:
```
*** Booting Zephyr OS build zephyr-v3.1.0  ***


[00:00:00.505,737] <inf> net_config: Initializing network
[00:00:00.505,767] <inf> net_config: Waiting interface 1 (0x80002408) to be up...
```

review_comments:
Just a suggestion: move the definition of `buffer` here for targets where `CONFIG_RANDOM_BUFFER_NOCACHED` won't be selected, to improve readability. Something like this:

```
#ifdef CONFIG_RANDOM_BUFFER_NOCACHED
__attribute__((__section__(".nocache")))
static uint8_t buffer[BUFFER_LENGTH] = {0};
#else
static uint8_t buffer[BUFFER_LENGTH] = {0};
#endif
```
